step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the insurability issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — non-insurable employment — [employer’s name].”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD for the voluntary disclosure issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — voluntary disclosure allowed.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Explain that the client meets the 2 conditions for the National Policy on Voluntary Disclosure . National Policy on Voluntary Disclosure

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 4.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
On the Terminated tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 4.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if an MA is imposed to stop payments for the insurability

ul.li: If an MA is imposed, go to step 5.
If an MA is not imposed, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA and input the disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA.
Effective: Enter the w/c of the BPC.
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) and input the disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Effective: Enter the w/c of the BPC.
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s status by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 3.
If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 8.
If any other status is displayed, go to step 15.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 9.
If all rows are blank, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “waiting for an updateable status in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 9.
If all rows are blank, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.

step.cmd: On the Disentitlement tab, input the disentitlement on the Disentitlement section as follows (up to 3 disentitlements in BCS can be imposed or rescinded):

ul.li: Start date: Enter the w/c of the BPC.
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 14.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 17.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Message : Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim to cancel.
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “ D14 from w/c XXXX to 9999. ”
Remarks line 2: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the letter D-01-00-00. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976):
D5, D12, D13, D14, D23 (3011) .
D14 - Claim cancelled - Various reasons (3019) .
Select D14 - CRA insurability ruling .
Select BPC Date - Sunday’s date (1060) .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no OP.
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and active claim .
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and inactive claim .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-70-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Voluntary disclosure / Administrative Rule - Undeclared Earnings(2664):
Voluntary disclosure of information .
Subjects of the voluntary disclosure (2665): Select Text: Insert appropriate reason(s) (1618) and type “insurability of employment.”

Blank/Reminder: Provide information on report (2667)
Provide full and accurate information on each report and correct any incorrect reports as soon as possible .
Overpayment messages (2452): Select the appropriate option.

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Reason: Select Other and type “Non-insurable employment — voluntary disclosure.”

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a CR Recalculation WI pending or unassigned in the related WIs for this BPC:
Create an AI WI as follows:

ul.li: End User: Select Next available user .
Comments: Type “Level 1 recalculation — Integrity case [Integrity case number].”

Details: Type “ROE [serial number] is not insurable. A recalculation of BPC [DD-MM-YYYY] is not required. Complete the Claim Review Recalculation work item and clear the recalculation registration number for this BPC, if necessary.”

step.cmd: Complete the CR Integrity WI.
